newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS-Huge T-bond call spread commands attention.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-Huge T-bond call spread commands attention.

text.p: A large-size two-by-three call spread in December Treasury bond options was the talk of the floor Wednesday, traders said.

A dealer was said to have sold 20,000 December 116-00 calls and bought 30,000 of the 118-00 calls in a spread. Earlier, another dealer executed the same spread 3,000 by 4,500 times, bond floor brokers said.
Though the transaction was remarkable for its sheer size, traders said it was likely the customer was rolling or hedging a position rather than establishing the trade outright.

Implied volatility for September options was roughly unchanged on the day, estimated at 8.10 percent in the 116-00 calls and 8.15 percent in the 117-00 calls, underpinned as the bond market braces for two days of important U.S. economic news, traders said.
December at-the-money volatility was pegged at 8.75 percent.
In the underlying futures, the September bond contract continued its steep uptrend, ascending to the highest level since February 1996.

Advance second-quarter U.S. gross domestic product is due out Thursday, along with the Chicago purchasing managers' July survey. The national purchasers' survey will be reported Friday, following the July U.S. employment report.
Analysts estimated GDP growth slowed to 1.9 percent from the first-quarter's torrid 5.9 percent pace.
July non-farm payrolls are forecast up an average 193,000 versus June's 217,000 rise and the unemployment rate is seen slipping back to 4.9 percent from 5.0 percent.
In Eurodollar options, a U.S. banking firm was an aggressive seller of as many as 10,000 December 94.25 straddles, floor brokers said. They said March 94.00 straddles also attracted sellers.
The straddle selling helped depress volatilities by about 0.50 percentage point in December and 0.75 percentage point in March, continuing the year-long downtrend.
"There's just not a lot of uncertainty out there in the market," said a Eurodollar broker.
